title: SonarQube User token (squ_): benign public id controls
summary: 1 input holding public identifiers that sit next to the credential and look like it but are not secret.
rationale: Providers publish identifiers (account, key or client ids) beside their secrets. Reporting one is a false alarm, and redacting it removes information a reader legitimately needs.

expectation.rationale: Public identifier constructed to contain no credential: silence follows from construction.
